scope: Pre-publication acceptance; archive and Git/remote readback are subsequent delivery steps.
platform: Windows; Python 3.11.0; headless SDL and app-local native Workbench

criteria.observed: Actual source equals commissioned SYS-5 baseline; historical/proposed sources labeled.
All nineteen commissioned domains and eleven families have explanation and routes; existing detailed chapters retained/reconciled.
Four entry routes; required intent searches prioritize current guides.
Fourteen full lessons, hints/answers, variations, faults, independent tasks and restart guidance.
Full new primitive, real hook lifecycle and unfamiliar persisted subsystem with installation/recovery.
Actual packaged authoring, typography and captured-room UI checks; obsolete exploratory assertions disclosed.
Item, passive recipe/output use, guard approach/retreat, owned room and real generated selection/construction.
Supplies, needs, target/entrance staging and deterministic boundary controls labeled; no full campaign claim.
Free rejection/cancel, exact physical consumption, accepted/missed timing, no render tick and hook deduplication.
New interpreter equality/continued jobs/hooks; actual checksum-valid malformed/absent save cases; scene leave/reentry.
No production module/data installed; no tracked production code/data diff; explicit new save roots before construction; exact conflict-checked patch recovery.
Chromium/Firefox direct and moved file reading/search/navigation/images/answers/downloads offline.
Plain external notes copied and byte-checked; blocked browser storage does not break reading/search/theme. No browser-only course progress.
Desktop/light/dark/narrow/keyboard/expanded print inspected; 200% CSS viewport/device-pixel equivalent, not native chrome zoom or screen-reader certification.
Source/authoring/product binding; Workbench and lesson helpers included; conservative impact hints, no prose auto-approval.
Clean external pinned packages/browser binaries installed; documented serial gate passed; repeated builds identical.
Automation establishes bounded scenario behavior and documentation consistency, not comprehension/retention.

preservation.personal_campaigns: Not opened or used; checks use explicit newly allocated fixture roots. No claim of a campaign-byte comparison because personal campaigns were not inspected.
preservation.unrelated_owner_work: Existing untracked art and proposal excluded from staging; preserved.

publication: Authorized scoped commit/push and exact remote main readback follow packaging; final delivery supplies the resulting revision.
